S48.name: 深海巨型鳐
S48.form: a very wide diamond disc with a broad wing span, a pair of short cephalic lobes, a long thin whip-like tail, smooth matte skin
S48.fins: broad wing-like pectoral fins fused to the disc, a small dorsal fin near the tail base
S48.markings: a sparse row of luminous pores along the wing margin
S48.colour: 深海底栖灰褐底、翼缘微光，腹面浅

S50.name: 深海鳚
S50.form: a slender elongated body, a blunt rounded head, a small terminal mouth, large eyes set high, no barbels, naked skin with no scales
S50.fins: a long continuous dorsal fin with a shallow notch, a long anal fin, small pectoral fins
S50.markings: faint vertical bars crossing the flank
S50.colour: 海底泥青底、腹部浅，眼周深色

S54.name: 孔灯鱼
S54.form: a small compact body, a large head, a short blunt snout, large eyes, a large luminous organ set below the eye
S54.fins: a short dorsal fin, a short anal fin, small pectoral fins, a slightly forked tail fin
S54.markings: a row of luminous pores along the flank, a luminous patch below the eye
S54.colour: 深蓝底、眼下灯点冷青，体侧星屑

S56.name: 狼牙鲷
S56.form: a deep laterally compressed body, a large head, a moderate eye, a row of exposed fangs along both jaws, ctenoid scales
S56.fins: a spiny dorsal fin with stout front spines, a short anal fin with two spines, a forked tail fin
S56.markings: a line of pores along the head, a blotch at the base of the tail fin
S56.colour: 深鲷青底、棘缘冷金，牙列象牙白

S57.name: 角高体金眼鲷
S57.form: a deep diamond-shaped body, a steep forehead with a short frontal crest, a very large eye, a small terminal mouth, ctenoid scales
S57.fins: a long spiny dorsal fin, a short anal fin, a forked tail fin
S57.markings: a row of raised spines along the back, a spot at the base of the tail fin
S57.colour: 深海青底、大眼冷金环，背棘浅灰

S59.name: 海沟幽魂·无光鲸
S59.form: a massive rounded body, a broad blunt head, deep parallel throat pleats, a smooth matte hide that barely reflects light
S59.fins: long slim pectoral flippers, a small set-back dorsal fin, a wide notched horizontal fluke
S59.markings: a sparse scattering of faint luminous points across the back
S59.colour: 幽魂墨黑底、几乎无光，腹面深灰

S60.name: 海沟之主·深渊巨鲨
S60.form: a massive heavy body, a broad streamlined head with a short tapered snout, wide jaws lined with rows of triangular teeth, five long gill slits
S60.fins: a tall triangular dorsal fin, long swept pectoral fins, a crescent tail fin with a long upper lobe
S60.markings: faint ridge lines banding the flanks
S60.colour: 深渊漆黑底、吸光哑面，牙列冷白

S61.name: 幽蓝海心·鬼灯笼
S61.form: a very deep rounded body, a very large head, an enormous upward-gaping mouth, extremely long fangs, a large bulbous lure hanging on a long rod over the snout
S61.fins: small rounded pectoral fins, a short dorsal fin, a rounded tail fin
S61.markings: a large luminous lure over the snout, a row of pores along the jaw
S61.colour: 幽蓝黑底、诱饵冷蓝光，牙尖惨白

S62.name: 海沟终焉·原始巨口鲨
S62.form: a massive deep body, a broad head with a short tapered snout, an enormous gape mouth reaching far back, small teeth in many rows, five long gill slits
S62.fins: a rounded dorsal fin set far back, large swept pectoral fins, a long crescent tail fin
S62.markings: a row of luminous pores along the flank
S62.colour: 终焉墨青底、巨口冷白内衬，背脊深纹
